get.description:
Also serves thumbnails of trashed assets (the trash lists them).

`size` (256, 512, 1024): the nearest stored thumbnail not smaller than requested (else the largest), with an
`ETag` keyed by the thumbnail id and an immutable cache lifetime.

post.description: "Respaldar ahora": lifts the Wi-Fi rule for the current backlog (battery and thermal rules still apply).

get.description: Phone-backup header: pending work, what it waits for, today's progress, and media access.

`sort` (`name|modified|size|kind`) puts folders first; without it the listing is newest first, mixed.
`order` defaults to `asc` (`desc` for `modified`). Keep the same `sort`/`order` across a cursor's pages.

`topics`: comma-separated subset of `library,jobs,imports,sync` (default: all). Events:
`ready` (`data: {"topics": [...]}`) once, then `change` (`data: {"topics": ["library", ...]}`) whenever a
watched topic changed; `: ping` comments while idle. The server ends the stream after `max_seconds`;
reconnect (the `retry` hint is 3 s) and refetch what you show, since changes are not replayed.

delete.description: Deletes the album on every device; its photos stay in the library.

patch.description: `title` renames (synced); `cover_asset_id` picks the cover among the album's photos, `null` clears it.

get.description: Months with photo counts and a cursor to jump to each (fast scroller): one grouped query.

`origin` keeps assets this device got a given way (`device`, `peer`, `telegram`, `telegram_inbox`,
`telegram_import`); folders and albums are left out while it is set.
